bio: Patrick McIver was born in Ireland. He is the presumed father of Margaret McIver, the wife of Edward F. Jones of Plymouth, Pennsylvania. Margaret was born in England to an Irish father and an English mother, which fits an Irish-born Patrick who had settled in England; her maiden name was later written down as "Kiver" by one of her sons. He was John's 4th-great-grandfather.

researchNotes: The 1880 census of his presumed daughter Margaret (Mrs. Edward F. Jones) at Plymouth Township gives her father's birthplace as Ireland and her mother's as England ([R4-S1]), consistent with an Irish-born Patrick McIver living in England. Margaret's son Joseph's 1914 marriage docket writes her maiden name as "Kiver" ([R4-S2]). No record naming Patrick himself was found.
summary: Irish-born father of Margaret McIver, the wife of Edward F. Jones of Plymouth, Pennsylvania; John's 4th-great-grandfather.
